shared_elements: carved stone monument with rounded/arched upper contour
low-relief incised carving on a tan-brown stone surface
human figure(s) rendered with schematic profile head
horizontal dividing bands separating zones of the surface
justification: Both are upright, tan stone monuments with a rounded top whose surfaces are divided by horizontal bands into zones containing schematic human imagery and repeated small motifs, which gives a comparable silhouette at first glance. The decisive differences are that A is a massive three-dimensional sculpted figure whose carving follows a bodily volume in deep, weathered relief, while B is a flat slab covered in fine, shallow, ruled registers of dense repeated signs with small seated profile figures — quite different techniques and organising logic.
